def transform(grid):
    # The marked object is the largest solid-color component; return its one-cell interior.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 6, 7, 9))
    color = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    cells = [(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v == color]
    rs = [r for r,c in cells]; cs = [c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1,c0,c1 = min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    # Return the solid inner core after trimming the outermost row/column.
    return [[color for _ in range(c1-c0-1)] for _ in range(r1-r0-1)]
